blocks.answer: Yes. You may submit a deletion request. Some records may need to be retained for legally permitted or required purposes.

blocks.question: Can I request a copy of my personal information?
blocks.answer: You may submit an access request, subject to applicable legal rights and verification requirements.

blocks.question: Can I stop receiving promotional emails?
blocks.answer: Yes. Use an unsubscribe option where available or contact our support team.

blocks.question: Does Orvexo Electronics sell customer information?
blocks.answer: Whether particular data disclosures constitute a legal "sale" depends on the technologies actually used and applicable law. We do not make a blanket claim without verifying our data practices.

blocks.question: Can I opt out of targeted advertising?
blocks.answer: Where applicable, you may request an opt-out through the available privacy controls or by contacting us.

blocks.question: Does deleting cookies delete my order history?
blocks.answer: No. Deleting browser cookies does not automatically delete transaction records or customer account information.

blocks.question: Can I submit a privacy request without an account?
blocks.answer: Yes. You may contact us using the published email address. We may need to verify your identity for certain requests.

blocks.question: Can I request information about Afterpay or Affirm financing data?
blocks.answer: For information independently controlled by a financing provider, you may need to contact that provider directly.
